scope: Refresh ACadSharp ACIS writer maturity and open-source kernel availability; refine existing local transport/graph and composed semantic-validation owners without adding per-slice external work.

method.kind: Primary-source web research with local plan cross-check
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing S8/PAR-07 ACIS carrier, writer, owner, and consumer gates
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing ACDSDATA multi-chunk and AcDs association research/test owners
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: findings/subplan totals and deferred external J statuses
method.limitations: GitHub main branches and PR pages are mutable. PR discussion statements about TrueView/ODA validation are participant-reported; the external artifacts, exact tool builds, logs, and independent geometry expectations were not present in this research pass. This evidence does not establish a current released peer capability or prove that no open-source candidate exists globally.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp issue scope and unmerged contributor writer
evidence.observed: ACadSharp issue #1195 remains open and describes a DXF writer omission observed on version 3.4.9 using customer DWGs not publicly attached. Contributor PR #1150 remains open and shows no deployment. Its discussion describes pre-2013 DXF SAT text in groups 1/3, later DXF SAB through ACDSDATA owner handles, pre-2013 DWG entity-stream payload blocks, and R2013+ AcDs section data. The contributor reports external TrueView/ODA checks, but this pass did not obtain the files, tool identities, logs, or independently authored semantic expectations.
doesNotEstablish: ACadSharp current release or master supports these writer paths
the proposed route is a normative format rule
the unavailable customer drawings reproduce against libdxfrw
payload transport proves valid topology or B-rep semantics
evidence.planUse: Use PR #1150 as a source/versioned carrier-route lead only. Retain per-target version and direction gates, handle/owner identity, exact payload disposition, and independent reopen/geometry checks. Do not wait on or execute the unmerged branch in the implementation fast loop.

evidence.topic: ACadSharp schema refactor and writer dependency state
evidence.observed: Maintainer PR #1174 remains open and introduces a structured CadFileDataStorage schema/property model and embedded records. In the Oct. 1 discussion on #1150, its contributor reports that the branch conflicts with the refactor and that the post-refactor DXF reader retained only the last repeated group 310; the maintainer states that a schema-recreating writer is desired instead of copying raw storage. Maintainer PR #1240 remains open, shows no deployment, depends on #1174, and describes ModelerGeometry serialization with ACIS, wireframe and silhouette data plus version checks/warnings.
doesNotEstablish: the reported group-310 regression occurs in a current released package
the local libdxfrw path has the same behavior
either open PR is a usable or reproducible peer artifact
the writer design is complete or accepted by independent CAD tools
evidence.planUse: Reuse local generated multi-chunk ACDSDATA and owner/index test owners. Keep the future writer graph/schema-aware and fail atomically when the target route cannot preserve required identity or payload. Recheck ACadSharp only at the planned composed checkpoint after a relevant release/refactor/writer state is available.

evidence.topic: Open-source OCCT and ACIS kernel route boundary
evidence.observed: The official OCCT Components preview lists DXF and ACIS SAT/SAB import-export among commercial extensions separate from the open-source OCCT core. This supports treating OCCT-backed product routes as potentially authorized optional components, not as bundled open-source core functionality.
doesNotEstablish: commercial components are unavailable to every user
a license or installed component is available in this task
that no other open-source ACIS reader or kernel exists
any particular payload will produce a valid solid
evidence.planUse: Do not add commercial OCCT components as dependencies or purchase/install them. Keep any already-authorized use optional and separately labeled; account for shared OCCT kernel lineage with FreeCAD, cq-acis, and CAD Assistant. If unavailable, record NOT_AVAILABLE and continue local work.

evidence.topic: FreeCAD and ezdxf are not stock ACIS semantic validators
evidence.observed: FreeCAD issue #18454 states that stock FreeCAD cannot read proprietary ACIS blobs in DXF; its project documentation distinguishes the C++ and legacy importer profiles. ezdxf exposes raw SAT/SAB inspection and basic helpers, but its drawing-backend documentation says ACIS rendering is unsupported and lacks a 3D renderer.
doesNotEstablish: a pinned current FreeCAD build's explicit-entity behavior on either OS
all FreeCAD optional plugins have identical ACIS scope
ezdxf cannot preserve or inspect any ACIS carrier bytes
DXF structural parsing or wireframe visibility proves B-rep semantics
evidence.planUse: Keep stock FreeCAD Linux/Windows runs scoped to the exact converter-to-DXF-to-importer route and entity profile. Keep raw carrier inspection, strict DXF parse, application geometry, ACIS B-rep semantics, and native operations as separate evidence results.

readinessRefinement: treat ACadSharp #1150 and #1240 as unmerged, non-deployed leads; do not wait for or run them during local slices
retain target-version-specific SAT/SAB carrier and entity/owner/index closure checks, including multi-chunk reads and atomic writer refusal
keep all available OCCT ACIS components outside the open-source-core and dependency claims; use only if already authorized and label shared-kernel lineage
run native FreeCAD Linux/Windows qualification and independent ACIS/ACDS semantic validation only at existing composed checkpoints
stop broad candidate rediscovery until a concrete release, independently audited route, or authorized runtime changes availability
